title: Flowers for a Thank-You
context: Jules 在花店请店员 Aaron 帮忙挑一束送给老师的花，并选择简单包装。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: I would like some flowers to thank my teacher. Could you help me choose?
dialogue.zh: 我想买些花感谢老师。你能帮我挑选吗？

dialogue.speaker: Aaron
dialogue.en: Of course. Do you have a color in mind?
dialogue.zh: 当然。你想好要什么颜色了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: She likes yellow, and I would like something cheerful.
dialogue.zh: 她喜欢黄色，我想要看起来明快的花。

dialogue.speaker: Aaron
dialogue.en: These yellow daisies look lovely with the white ones.
dialogue.zh: 这些黄色雏菊和白色的搭配很好看。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: They do. Could you make a small bunch with both colors?
dialogue.zh: 确实。能用这两种颜色扎一小束吗？

dialogue.speaker: Aaron
dialogue.en: Certainly. How much would you like to spend?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。你想花多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: About twenty dollars, if that is enough for a small bunch.
dialogue.zh: 大约二十美元，如果够买一小束的话。

dialogue.speaker: Aaron
dialogue.en: Yes, this bunch comes to eighteen dollars. Would you like a ribbon?
dialogue.zh: 够的，这束十八美元。你想加一条丝带吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: A simple green ribbon would be great. Is that included?
dialogue.zh: 一条简单的绿色丝带就很好。这个价格包括丝带吗？

dialogue.speaker: Aaron
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. I can wrap the stems in paper, too.
dialogue.zh: 包括的。我还可以用纸把花茎包起来。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: Thank you. I will write her a note when I get home.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我回家后会给她写张便条。

dialogue.speaker: Aaron
dialogue.en: Here you are. I hope she enjoys the flowers.
dialogue.zh: 给你。希望她喜欢这些花。

expressions.example: Do you have a color in mind for the card?
He picked a small bunch of flowers.
The two notebooks come to ten dollars.
Is the card included in the price?
Please wrap the stems in paper.

pronunciation: daisies 的重音在第一音节，结尾发 /z/ 音；bunch 以 /tʃ/ 结尾，与 lunch 的结尾相同。

practice.title: Part 1 · Flowers
practice.answer: Yes. A small bunch can make a room feel brighter, and I like knowing someone chose it for me.

practice.title: Part 2 · A thoughtful present
practice.prompt: Describe a small present you gave someone. Say who received it, how you chose it, and how they reacted.
practice.answer: I once gave my teacher a small bunch of yellow flowers at the end of a course. I chose yellow because she often wore a yellow scarf. At the flower shop, I asked for a simple ribbon and stayed within my budget. I added a short note to thank her for encouraging me. She smiled and put the flowers on her desk. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Giving
practice.prompt: Why do people sometimes value a simple gift?
practice.answer: A simple gift can show that the giver paid attention to the recipient. The thought and the occasion may matter more than the price.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读挑选颜色和询问总价的句子，然后向店员描述你想买的花。
practice.answer: I would like a small bunch in pink and white. I can spend about twenty dollars. Is the ribbon included?
